reviews.text: Excellent attention and care for your pets.

I loved discovering Brio Veterinary Clinic!!
Plus, they have a daycare and hotel for my furry friends ❤️
Excellent place
They're always attentive to my dogs' needs, and I feel very confident leaving them there.
Thank you so much, Erik! Greetings to Cocoa!
Thank you Ivan for your trust!! We look forward to seeing Rolly and Bastian soon!! Kuno coming soon 🐶🐶🐶 …
Excellent service, my pet was a difficult case and everything turned out very well!

We've left Milow at Brío a few times when we've had to travel, and I must say it was a very good experience for us. Milow is a senior dog, a little nervous, but they were incredibly patient with him. They created an adaptation plan for us so my dog ​​could gradually get used to the place and the people. Dr. Anie was incredibly dedicated and made Milow feel more and more comfortable. On one occasion, we had to leave him while he was still under observation after major surgery, and their care was amazing. They reported to us every day whether he had eaten, how he was feeling, and so on. Milow was always very well cared for there. I am so grateful for their attention to our big guy; they were always so loving and patient.

We took our Milo to Brio and I can't thank the whole team enough for the wonderful, humane, and professional treatment he received 🐶💛 From the moment we arrived, we felt the positive energy, the care they put into their work, and the trust they inspire. Milo was happy, cared for, and pampered the entire time.

Thank you so much for treating him with so much love and for making us dog parents feel so at ease 🐾✨
It's so wonderful to find places like this! 💕

I can guarantee that Brío is an excellent place. They take good care of the dogs, they're attentive, they feed and hydrate them, the dogs socialize and play with the other dogs who have already been evaluated, they give their medication to those who need it, they send you updates throughout the day on your dog's condition, they give them lots of love and affection, they sleep in a safe place, the place is clean, if your dog doesn't want to eat they'll let you know so you can find a solution, they even dressed them up for Halloween and the doctors are very nice people. 😊
Excellent service, my dogs love going to their daycare there. They give them different activities every day and send you videos and photos of their activities.

I've been a customer of Brío for some time now, and I've noticed a decline in their attention and care for my dogs, as well as a price increase. My last experience was with an older dog (for whom they charge extra for special care), and the lack of attention to both his care and the recommendations we made was clear (I had to insist they send me reports when before they did so up to four times a day). He came in good condition and they returned him in very bad shape (very thin, dirty, and sick), demonstrating the lack of care. I hope this serves as a warning to anyone considering leaving their adult dog with them to think twice; I won't be going back.
Excellent place to have your pet cared for. The staff is friendly, responsible, and you can tell they adore dogs.
Excellent pet care; they're very good with my blind dog. Highly recommended.

A very empathetic place for our pets. My dog ​​thoroughly enjoyed her stay. They conducted a very professional behavioral assessment. Their check-in and check-out protocols are excellent, and they take the time to explain everything in detail to our pets. I highly recommend it.

They care for pets like they're in a kindergarten. Entry requirements to ensure their well-being include an up-to-date ID, appointment confirmation, etc. They keep you informed throughout your pet's stay, providing behavior reports, photos, videos, etc. You can return your pet by appointment, with all the necessary documentation. 👏👏👏 …
Excellent service, they take great care of my dog ​​Bongo, they are very attentive to him

Brio is a place where they treat dogs with great respect, always giving them ample time to adjust to their stay or any veterinary care. I've left my dogs there a couple of times, and they've always sent me updates twice a day, answered my questions, and been very transparent. They also keep up with vaccinations to prevent diseases among the dogs.
When I pick up my dogs, they always come out happy, and I see them socializing with the other dogs. I highly recommend this place for dog care.
The best place to care for your dog, they keep you informed and are very loving, they don't keep them locked up, my dog ​​is very happy at Brio
Highly recommended. The follow-up and attention from ALL THE STAFF is excellent. I like how they treat the animals and their owners.
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! 🙂 Greetings to Kira! …
Excellent place, very good service.
Thank you so much, Angel, for your review! We hope to see you soon!
I love Brio! The best dog hotel in Guadalajara! The staff is super friendly and they have options for reactive dogs!
They are super cute and professional with the care of your furry friend, my Mazapán is always the happiest when she goes, whether it's to daycare to do her favorite activities or for overnight stays!

My little ones loved it!! The staff was very friendly and well-trained in handling the dogs!! 🐶🐶🐶🐶🐶
Their facilities are perfectly suited and safe for the little ones to play and have a blast.
Kiki, Bruna, Fabio, Nerón, and Petunia were so happy and can't wait to go back! 🐾
They deliver on all their promises; the dogs are treated with dignity and kindness. You can tell they do their job with dedication and love ♥️

Their services are excellent, always keeping in mind the comfort of your dog and the others. In my case, my dog ​​didn't pass the adaptation test, which I accept and acknowledge, but they can still provide bathing, vaccinations, etc., without any problem. My other dog did pass her adaptation test and can now come for day passes to socialize with other dogs. 🐾 This makes me think highly of how committed and responsible they are in pet care.
They are very strict with their opening hours.
